tabs.label: Editor view
tabs.refused: The spec has errors, so the form can't show it. Fix them first.

caution.body: This service has additional settings not shown here. Saving from this form keeps them unchanged. See the Spec tab.

name.label: Name
name.helper: Letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore. Up to 63 characters.
name.readOnly: A service's name can't change. Create a new service instead.

image.label: Image
image.helper: TierPlan pins the tag to its current digest when you apply.

mode.label: Mode
mode.job: Jobs are created and edited in the Spec tab only.

environment.title: Environment variables
environment.hiddenHelper: Values are hidden. A hidden value stays as it is unless you type a new one.

ports.title: Ports
ports.modeHelper: Ingress: any node answers on this port and passes traffic to a task. Host: only nodes running a task answer.

mounts.title: Mounts
mounts.bindNotice: A bind mount gives tasks access to a folder on whichever node runs them, and the folder must exist on every node that can run the service. Folders under /srv, /mnt and /media are open to Operators; any other host path or the Docker socket needs Admin.

resources.title: Resources
resources.reservationHelper: Swarm only places a task on a node with this much free.

placement.title: Placement
placement.spreadHelper: Swarm spreads the tasks evenly across the values of this node label.
placement.moreSpreads_one: {{count}} more preference is kept as it is. Edit it in the Spec tab.
placement.moreSpreads_other: {{count}} more preferences are kept as they are. Edit them in the Spec tab.

restart.title: Restart policy
restart.windowHelper: How long a task must run before it counts as started.

update.title: Update policy
update.orderHelper: Start first brings the new task up before the old one stops.
update.monitorHelper: How long to watch each updated task for a failure.
update.maxFailureRatioHelper: The share of tasks that may fail, from 0 to 1, before the update counts as failed.

autoRollback.label: Roll back automatically if an update fails
autoRollback.helper: Saved on the service, so every later update uses it, including one-click image updates.
autoRollback.reviewHelper: Saved on the service. Later updates, including one-click image updates, use the same policy.
autoRollback.continues: Currently set to continue on failure. Ticking this changes it to roll back.

errors.nameInvalid: Use letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore.
errors.image: Enter an image like nginx:1.27 or ghcr.io/acme/app:latest.
errors.whole: Enter a whole number of 0 or more.
errors.portTwice: That published port is used twice.
errors.cores: Enter a number of cores like 0.5.
errors.absolutePath: Enter an absolute path that starts with /.

secret.title: Create a secret
secret.body: It's created when you apply the service. Docker never shows the value again.

config.title: Create a config
config.body: It's created when you apply the service.

network.title: Create a network
network.body: It's created when you apply the service, as an attachable overlay network.

errors.nameInvalid: Use letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore.
errors.subnet: The subnet must be in CIDR form, like 10.20.0.0/24.

secrets.title: Secrets
secrets.needsReveal: Needs the reveal secrets permission to add a secret

configs.title: Configs
configs.runtime: {{name}} is read by Docker at run time, not mounted. It's kept as it is.

networks.title: Networks
networks.aliasesHelper: Other names services on this network can use.
